facts.text: A toast to Mary's lamp across the garden.
facts.why: Mary moves in next door to Freddie, and he has her look out her window at him, but no lamp or garden is mentioned.
facts.fix: A toast to Mary, just next door.

facts.text: Coins dropped on the drum skins for a new sound
facts.why: No scene with coins on the drum skins turns up in the script or the plot.
facts.fix: Freddie's ring in a box, proposing to Mary

facts.text: A house full of cats with their own rooms
facts.why: Freddie shows off the house and says each cat will have his own room, with Delilah by the kitchen.

vibe.verdict: A grand Wembley stadium menu with a clever Parsi food angle for Freddie's family, but the best Queen moments, like Bismillah and the coffee machine, are missing.
missing: 'Not the coffee machine!' (Roger, the EMI meeting)
Ray Foster's 'six bloody minutes' and 'I'm in Love with My Car' (EMI office)
Roger dressed like a chicken at the farm studio (Rockfield)
The 'fruit fly' speech when Freddie fires Paul
'Good thoughts, good words, good deeds' (Freddie and his father)
ideas: Swap the shandy note for a toast to 'Good thoughts, good words, good deeds'.
Swap the Pimm's note for a toast to Mary.
Swap the sausage note for 'I'm in Love with My Car' burger, Roger's pick.
Add a 'Miami Beach' mocktail in place of a cold drink.
